_schema: ORDER-2026-09-27-06 founder ruling 2, extended by the CADWIZ STATUS follow-up ruling 2 (2026-09-29). Some models reject a request parameter or value the vendored client (vendor/freecad-ai, pinned, never edited in place) always sends. Keys are "provider/model" exactly matching what CADWiz records. Values: {"omit_params": [<param names to strip from the request body for this model>], "tool_choice_override": <value to force tool_choice to instead of the vendored client's own forced "any"/"tool"/"required", e.g. "auto">}. omit_params: confirmed live 2026-09-28, these Anthropic models return HTTP 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model' the moment `temperature` appears in the request body at all. tool_choice_override: confirmed live 2026-09-29, claude-opus-5-5 returns HTTP 400 'tool_choice: type "tool" and "any" are not supported for this model' -- the vendored client's own _send_anthropic_tools always sets body["tool_choice"] = {"type": "any"} when require_tool_call is set. A model not listed here that hits either class of error is auto-added to that behavior for the rest of the current session (logged plainly) even before a human adds a permanent entry here -- see _patch_anthropic_body_for_param_omission and _patch_http_post_for_usage_capture in src/integrations/llm/vendored_client.py.
